# TDPdf v1.23.6.0

**Fixes Insert Text Box activation and pulls in applicable reliability fixes from KillerPDF v1.7.4/v1.7.5.**

TDPdf previously attached its focus callback only to Windows' `Loaded` event. A dynamically-added text box can already be loaded before that handler is attached, so the callback never runs and the editor silently receives no keyboard input.

The editor lifecycle is now wired before the text box enters the page, and an idempotent dispatcher fallback always attempts activation whether `Loaded` fires before or after registration. Lost-focus handling is also attached independently so commit and cancel behavior remains complete.

This release also:

- prevents huge or invalid print ranges from freezing the app or unexpectedly printing every page;
- keeps the print window responsive while sheets are composed and sent to the spooler;
- prevents a print job from being triggered twice while it is already running;
- preserves and rotates unsaved annotations when a page is rotated, clamping placed items inside the new bounds; and
- commits a live text box before Transform builds its preview.

## For administrators

The Intune detection rule now requires 1.23.6.0, so managed machines pick this up on the next evaluation. Assignments are unaffected.

## Verifying this download

The executable is signed by *The Doodle Project Code Signing*, a private certificate. On managed machines that trust it, the signature validates. On a machine that does not, Windows will still warn on first run. Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to confirm the download independently.
